# Pylex

> Pylex is a Python OCR library and command-line tool that makes scanned PDFs searchable and extracts text, confidence and position from images. It runs on CPU and NVIDIA GPU and installs from GitHub.

## Docs

- [Overview](https://github.com/voltvirtuoso/pylex/blob/main/docs/index.md): What Pylex is, when to use it, and when to choose something else.
- [Installation](https://github.com/voltvirtuoso/pylex/blob/main/docs/installation.md): Install profiles for CPU, Intel, NVIDIA CUDA 12 and 13; GPU checks; TPU and other hardware status.
- [Quickstart](https://github.com/voltvirtuoso/pylex/blob/main/docs/quickstart.md): Searchable PDF from the command line and from Python in five minutes.
- [Python SDK reference](https://github.com/voltvirtuoso/pylex/blob/main/docs/python-api.md): Python SDK reference: extract_text, create_searchable_document, Config, callbacks, GPU use.
- [CLI reference](https://github.com/voltvirtuoso/pylex/blob/main/docs/cli.md): Every command line option, defaults, exit codes, recipes, and pylex doctor.
- [How it works](https://github.com/voltvirtuoso/pylex/blob/main/docs/how-it-works.md): Rendering, tiling, vertical-text retry, and how the invisible text layer is built.
- [Accuracy and benchmarks](https://github.com/voltvirtuoso/pylex/blob/main/docs/accuracy-and-benchmarks.md): Choosing settings, recorded measurements, and a reproducible comparison harness.
- [Limitations](https://github.com/voltvirtuoso/pylex/blob/main/docs/limitations.md): What Pylex does not do, script and font limits, hardware support.
- [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/voltvirtuoso/pylex/blob/main/docs/troubleshooting.md): Fixes for install, GPU, model-download, and text-layer problems.
